content: This game has some very serious problems and I will list why I gave it two stars. (This is long. You have been warned) Firstly the game has a big problem when it comes to it’s server and lag. Due to the fact that you are matched up with people from all around the globe this is a given. But I think the problem can be reduced by creating servers for different continents. For example a European server for European players etc. Secondly there is an issue with the punishment system. It works based on credits. You have 100 a week (I think) and if you go below 80 you get banned from doing certain things. I believe it should be harsher as people who violate the rules have a very easy time getting back to 100 credits. With that being said I believe that the game punishes innocent people more than people who violate the rules. For example in a ranked match I had a person on the team who was feeding on purpose and it caused us to lose the game. This was in ranked so we ended up all losing a star which caused me to go down a tier. We reported him but it didn't matter because he would probably still be in the mid 90's and we had lost a star. The game doesn't allow you to keep your star after more than one incident like this which is not fair. Thirdly the game has a problem with spam. There are people in the chat rooms soliciting sex and nothing is being done about it. There are so many people doing it that there is no point reporting it anymore because another person will take it’s place. Fourthly the translate system needs some improvment I am usually in a team with people in places like Russia or China and therefore I really need to know what they are saying but the translate system is terrible. Lastly the game has a problem with toxic players. I don't mean players who say "rude" words I mean people who abandon the game midway on purpose, let people die on purpose because they are salty they didn't get a character they wanted, people who hack etc and like I said before due to how soft the punishment system is they get away with it. On the plus side the skins are nice (mostly). So you can pay money to look nice (mostly) in a very laggy game. Also the game can be quite addictive and when it works it is fun to play so I will give it that.
